prompt: Let $\mathcal C$ be a class of finite simple graphs. Extend the radius parameter to $r=\infty$, so resolved-pair reachability covers an entire connected component. Which class property is equivalent to $\sup_{G\in\mathcal C}\operatorname{mw}_\infty(G)<\infty$?

answers.explanation: The infinity-radius parameter is functionally equivalent to clique-width. Bounds at each fixed finite radius are weaker than one bound on whole resolved components.
Cliques have bounded clique-width and infinity-radius merge-width but unbounded maximum degree.
Cliques again have bounded infinity-radius merge-width but unbounded clique number.
Cliques have bounded clique-width but unbounded treewidth.
Square grids have bounded twin-width but unbounded clique-width, and therefore unbounded infinity-radius merge-width.

answers.text: Bounded merge-width at each fixed finite radius.
answers.explanation: Square grids have bounded merge-width at every fixed finite radius but unbounded clique-width.
Monadic dependence includes square grids and many classes of unbounded clique-width.
Paths have bounded clique-width, hence bounded infinity-radius merge-width, but unbounded shrubdepth.
This is stronger than bounded clique-width; for example cographs have bounded clique-width but unbounded linear clique-width.
Paths have bounded clique-width and unbounded neighbourhood diversity.
